Senses.Explanation: The three-without-difference of the Chan records: mind, buddha, and beings one — the one-body three treasures, the ten faiths and the five roads, the refuges unfolded, the bamboo and the pines, the water and the moon, and the life-release ground. Dazhu Huihai answers the monk Fayuan's three-treasure ask: mind is the buddha — don't seek buddha with buddha; mind is the way's law — don't seek law with law; no two in buddha and law, their harmony the assembly: that is the one-body three treasures. The sutra says: mind, buddha, and beings — the three without difference. Body, mouth, and intent clean: a buddha appears in the world; the three deeds unclean: the buddha's extinction. Like anger without joy, joy without anger — one mind only, truly no second body; the snake becomes a dragon without changing its scales, beings turn their minds to buddhahood without changing their faces, Yongming Yanshou glosses the Flowery-Adornment verse in his mirror of the school: as mind is, so the buddhas; as the buddha is, so the beings — mind, buddha, and beings, the three without difference — only one way, the names differ, the principle is one. Wake to this un-leaning un-abiding unconditioned unthinkable mind unmoved: the first of the ten faiths, named the unmoving-wisdom buddha; unwoken, the true mind not keeping its own nature, following conditions into difference: the law-body wandering the five roads, called the being — names of delusion and waking only, never leaving the one mind's body, Guting Shanjian seals his knowing-view treatise: true knowing knows without knowing-known, true seeing sees without seeing-seen — taking knowing-views as difference and seeing them one is delusion; waking through knowing-views and seeing them one is waking: mind, buddha, beings — the three without difference; the Wisdom sutra: no two, no two-parts, no difference, no cutting-off — and Huanyou Zhengchuan unfolds the refuges: taking refuge in the assembly — assembly is harmony's meaning: buddha just is law, law just is mind, mind buddha beings three without difference — also called mind-just-is-buddha, realm-just-is-mind: raise one and three, say three and one — so refuge in buddha done, refuge in law done, refuge in assembly done. Juyun Chuiwan Guangzhen takes the triple ask head on: mind, buddha, and beings, the three without difference — what is mind? A few stalks of bamboo before the gate. What is buddha? Several pines on the ridge. And are there beings or not? Mind, buddha, and beings — the three without difference. The monk bows; down from the seat, Wuhuan Xingchong praises the Water-Moon Guanyin: great wisdom like water, great fullness like the moon, the self-so body one — the three without difference. In this field of sights, who is born, who dies? I make this reading — mistaking the turtle for the soft-shell, and Zixian Jue releases the living: mind, buddha, beings — three without difference, the base-body thus-and-so, ever itself still and quenched. Before the Awesome-Sound one not one dust is set up; at this age's gate not one way is picked up — whatever has blood and breath knows alike; whatever knows shares one body — so the scaly and the feathered climb the awakened ground together, the coarse-bodied and fine-minded all partake of the awesome light. Turning the common into the worthy — yes, that there is.
